# Hairland

> Hairland is a Czech premium RAW hair extension retailer at hairland.cz. We sell unprocessed (RAW) human hair imported directly from 10+ countries. Hair is sold by the gram — customers pay only for the exact weight they need. We offer 3 quality tiers (Virgin, Luxe, Standard), lengths from 35 to 70 cm, and hair from Ukraine, Vietnam, Iran, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Cambodia, India, China, Mongolia, Georgia, Belarus, Moldova, Russia, and Syria. Prices range from 45 to 125 CZK per gram depending on origin, quality, and length. We serve both retail (B2C) and wholesale for salons (B2B with 15-30% discounts). Free in-person consultation and delivery in Prague. Nationwide shipping via Zasilkovna within 1-2 business days.

## Key Facts

- Business: Premium RAW human hair extensions (we sell hair, not application services)
- Unique selling point: Only specialized RAW hair retailer in Czech Republic
- Pricing model: Per-gram sales (no pre-packaged bundles, no waste)
- Quality tiers: Virgin (unprocessed, 18-36 month lifespan), Luxe (minimally processed, 12-24 months), Standard (processed, 6-12 months)
- Origins: 15 countries across Europe, Asia, and Middle East
- Lengths: 35-70 cm in 5 cm increments
- Methods supported: Clip-in, tape-in, keratin bonding, micro ring, weft/sew-in
- Languages: Czech, Ukrainian, Russian
- Location: Skolska 660/3, Prague 1, Czech Republic
- Contact: info@hairland.cz, +420 608 553 103
- B2B discounts: 15-30% off retail prices for registered salons
